chapter: The Los Angeles music scene in the early 1930s
title: Central Avenue clubs and the Hummingbird
summary: They talk about the 12th and Central area where musicians lived and the Hummingbird club, where Gene Wright and others played.

story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Much of the activity, I believe, at that time was around 12th and
Central, between 12th Street and Ninth Street, they were important streets at the time and I think Lionel Hampton lived in that area.
What were some of the names of the clubs at that time, Mr. Blakeney?
Did the Spike Brothers have a club at anytime?
Yes. I'm trying to think what they called it.
Was there a club, Mr. Blakeney, called the Hummingbird, in that area?
Who were some of the musicians who played at the Hummingbird Club near Twelfth and Central?
Gene Wright on piano, Harley Brooks.
